text: dsh-desktop-glass（DSH 桌面插件）：为桌面界面营造蓝色半透明毛玻璃效果。它通过浏览器端注入样式，让页面底色和侧栏透出窗口材质，为侧栏、中列和右栏添加渐变，并移除若干分隔线；面板挂载时还会淡入上浮，并尊重系统减少动态效果设置。适合希望调整 DSH 桌面外观的用户。Windows 上要看到桌面壁纸，还需单独应用窗口材质补丁；无需 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-desktop-glass (DSH desktop plugin) adds a translucent blue appearance. It softens page and sidebar backgrounds, adds column gradients, removes selected dividers, and animates panel entry with reduced-motion support. Showing wallpaper on Windows also requires the separate window-material patch.
想让 DSH 桌面界面变成半透明的蓝色毛玻璃风格。
能不能让桌面壁纸透过 DSH 窗口显示？
我想给 DSH 侧栏和内容区域加柔和渐变背景。
让桌面版的面板切换时带淡入上浮效果。
I want a translucent glass theme for the DSH desktop app.
Can the DSH window show my wallpaper through its page background?
dsh-desktop-glass 的功能「半透明页面」：将页面底色和侧栏填充改为半透明颜色，并令 Windows 桌面布局的窗口框架和对话根容器透明，配合窗口材质显示玻璃效果。通过安装插件启用。
dsh-desktop-glass 的功能「列渐变与边界调整」：为侧栏、中列和右栏设置不同方向的渐变，并移除中列圆角、导航下划线、dock 左边线和侧栏右边界。插件加载后自动生效。
dsh-desktop-glass 的功能「窗口材质补丁」：在 Windows 主窗口启用 acrylic 或 mica 材质与透明背景。运行配套脚本后，壁纸可透过窗口显示。
dsh-desktop-glass 的功能「面板进入动画」：中间和右侧列中的子面板挂载时淡入并轻微上浮；系统启用减少动态效果时关闭动画。安装插件后自动应用。
希望 DSH 页面背景更轻透，同时保留卡片清晰度。
I want subtle panel animations that respect reduced-motion settings.

**让你的桌面壁纸一览无余**

仅适用于 Windows ，使用系统自带的 Mica / Acrylic 材质。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 由插件本体和补丁两部分构成：窗口材质属于 Electron 主进程的 `BrowserWindow` 参数，位于 `app.asar` 的 `main.js` 。插件仅可注入 CSS。为达到完整效果,本包包含两样：

- **插件**（仓库根目录）—— 页面那半边：半透明底色、三列渐变、切换动画、去掉分隔线
- **补丁器**（`windows-acrylic/`）—— 窗口那半边：给主窗口补回 `backgroundMaterial` 和透明的 `backgroundColor`

只装插件，页面半透明但窗口不透明，无法看到壁纸；仅打补丁，窗口透明但页面任有纯色覆盖。二者需一同下载安装
section: 由插件本体和补丁两部分构成

text:
dsh-desktop-glass README · 安装：刚需 Node.js 18+。打补丁时用 `node --check` 校验语法，PATH 里找不到 node 的话脚本会去翻 DSH 自带的运行时。

先装插件：

```powershell
node scripts/install-plugin.mjs
```

它会把仓库拷到 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-desktop-glass`，再往 profile 的 `package.json` 里补上 bundle 条目和依赖声明。装完重启 DSH。

再打窗口材质补丁（Windows）：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\windows-acrylic\apply-acrylic.ps1
```

脚本会等着 DSH 退出。跑起来之后从托盘右键退出就行，它会自己打补丁再重启。

参数：`-Material mica` 换材质，`-AppRoot` 手动指定安装目录（默认自动探测），`-DryRun` 只检测和生成、不会更改已安装文件。
dsh-desktop-glass README · 安装：窗口若不透，先去 `设置 → 个性化 → 颜色` 把透明效果打开。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 调透明度：第 35–37 行的 `bg-layer-1/2/3` 为浮在内容上的卡片和面板表面，调透了设置界面会糊成一片,由作者亲身体验,没法看。

蓝色深浅度可修改三个渐变起点的 RGB。同色系由浅到深：`#F0F9FF` `#E0F2FE` `#BAE6FD` `#7DD3FC` `#38BDF8`。

改完重跑一遍安装脚本再重启。装的时候加了 `--link` 的话，改完直接重启即可。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 卸载：```powershell
node scripts/uninstall-plugin.mjs
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\windows-acrylic\restore-asar.ps1
```

插件仅会往页面里插一个 `<style>` 标签，卸掉就清清白白干干净净了。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 已知问题：**Acrylic 失焦会变实。** 这是 Windows 降级材质的行为，无法绕过。介意的话可尝试使用 `-Material mica`,但作者未能以其达成理想透明效果。

**DSH 更新会覆盖 `app.asar`**，以致插件失效，重跑一次补丁脚本即可。

**若 DSH 后续更新更改了主窗口结构**，补丁脚本会直接报错退出，不会动已安装的文件。

**如果某个构建开了 Electron 的 embedded asar integrity validation**，打完补丁起不来，可用 `restore-asar.ps1` 还原。目前 DSH 未开放。

改 `app.asar` 毕竟是对宿主程序动手，风险自己评估，插件仅作分享。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 原理：**插件。** Windows 布局的背景是由多层不透明色所叠出来的（`.frame` → `.centerCol` → `ConversationRoot.root`），每层哪怕只有 0.7 的 alpha，叠完也接近全不透明。macOS 版没这问题，其的 `.frame` 本身透明，vibrancy 可做得很透。所以插件把 `.frame` 设成完全透明，页面底色和侧栏调半透明，三列各铺一条渐变找层次。类名按 `[class*="_centerCol"]` 这种后缀匹配，前端重新构建换掉哈希名也不受影响。

**补丁。** `app.asar` 是「头部 JSON + 各条目字节」，头部记着每个条目的 offset、size 和完整性哈希。`main.js` 一长，后面所有条目的 offset 都得重算。所以补丁的做法是插两个属性、同时从一段注释里删掉等量字节，让 `main.js` 长度保持不变，只更新它自己的哈希。

dsh-desktop-glass README · 目录：```
package.json            插件清单，仓库根就是插件包
cordis.patch.yml        挂载插件用的 bundle patch
lib/client.js           浏览器半部，注入 CSS
lib/index.js            宿主半部，空的

`backups/`、`build/` 是跑脚本时生成的，已经 ignore 了。

dsh-desktop-glass README · dsh-desktop-glass：Frosted glass for the DSH desktop app. The window shows the desktop wallpaper through a translucent blue page, no divider lines.

<!-- drop a screenshot in and uncomment

-->

Full effect is Windows-only, since it uses the system Mica / Acrylic materials. Elsewhere the plugin still installs, but you only get the translucent page. Verified on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2.

[中文说明](README.md)

dsh-desktop-glass README · Why there are two parts：The window material is a `BrowserWindow` option in the Electron main process — it lives in `main.js` inside `app.asar`. A plugin can't reach it; a plugin can only inject CSS. So the full effect needs both:

- **The plugin** (repo root) — the page half: translucent background, per-column gradients, panel transitions, no dividers
- **The patcher** (`windows-acrylic/`) — the window half: puts `backgroundMaterial` and a transparent `backgroundColor` back on the main window
dsh-desktop-glass README · Why there are two parts：Plugin only: translucent page, opaque window, no wallpaper. Patcher only: see-through window, solid page. You need both.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Install：Needs Node.js 18+. The patcher runs `node --check` for syntax validation and falls back to the Node runtime bundled with DSH if `node` isn't on PATH.

Install the plugin:

```powershell
node scripts/install-plugin.mjs
```

It copies the repo into `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-desktop-glass` and adds the bundle entry and dependency to the profile's `package.json`. Restart DSH afterwards.

Apply the window-material patch (Windows):

dsh-desktop-glass README · Install：```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\windows-acrylic\apply-acrylic.ps1
```

It waits for DSH to exit. Run it, then quit DSH from the tray — it patches and restarts the app itself.

Options: `-Material mica`, `-AppRoot <dir>` if auto-detection misses, `-DryRun` to detect and generate without touching installed files.

If the window stays opaque, check `Settings → Personalization → Colors → Transparency effects`.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Tuning：Change the last number in the `rgba(...)` values in `lib/client.js`. Higher is more opaque.

| What | Line | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Page background | 33 | `rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.24)` |
| Sidebar | 34 | `rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.28)` |
| Column gradient start | 63 / 66 / 69 | `rgba(186, 230, 253, 0.42)` |
| Sidebar gradient end | 63 | `rgba(224, 242, 254, 0.14)` |
| Center / right gradient end | 66 / 69 | `rgba(240, 249, 255, 0.10)` |

dsh-desktop-glass README · Tuning：Leave `bg-layer-1/2/3` (lines 35–37) alone. Those are cards and panel surfaces floating above the content, and making them translucent smears the settings UI.

For a different shade of blue, change the RGB of the three gradient starts. Light to dark: `#F0F9FF` `#E0F2FE` `#BAE6FD` `#7DD3FC` `#38BDF8`.

Re-run the installer and restart. If you installed with `--link`, just restart.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Uninstall：```powershell
node scripts/uninstall-plugin.mjs
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\windows-acrylic\restore-asar.ps1
```

The plugin injects one `<style>` tag, so uninstalling leaves nothing behind.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Known issues：**Acrylic goes opaque when the window loses focus.** That's Windows downgrading the material; nothing to do about it. Use `-Material mica` if it bothers you — it degrades less.

**DSH updates overwrite `app.asar`**, so the glass disappears. Re-run the patcher.

**The patch trims a doc comment.** To keep `main.js` the same length it has to remove an equal number of bytes, and it takes them from a JSDoc comment. No effect on behaviour.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Known issues：**If DSH ever restructures the main window block**, the patcher fails loudly and leaves installed files untouched. It matches on an anchor, not a version.

**If a build enables Electron's embedded asar integrity validation**, patching will stop it from starting. Restore with `restore-asar.ps1`. Current DSH builds don't enable it.

Patching `app.asar` modifies the host application. Your call on the risk; also mind DSH's licence terms.

dsh-desktop-glass README · How it works：**Plugin.** In the Windows layout the background is a stack of opaque layers (`.frame` → `.centerCol` → `ConversationRoot.root`); even at alpha 0.7 the composite is nearly solid. macOS doesn't have this problem — its `.frame` is already transparent, which is why vibrancy shows through there. So the plugin makes `.frame` fully transparent, makes the page base and sidebar translucent, and puts a gradient on each column for depth. Class names are matched by suffix (`[class*="_centerCol"]`) so hashed build names don't matter.

dsh-desktop-glass README · How it works：**Patcher.** An asar is a header JSON plus raw entry bytes, and the header records each entry's offset, size and integrity hash. Growing `main.js` would shift every later entry. So the patch inserts the two properties and removes an equal number of bytes from a comment, keeping `main.js` the same length and only updating its own hash.

dsh-desktop-glass README · Layout：```
package.json            plugin manifest (repo root is the package)
cordis.patch.yml        bundle patch that mounts the plugin
lib/client.js           browser half, injects the CSS
lib/index.js            host half, empty

`backups/` and `build/` are generated at runtime and git-ignored.
dsh-desktop-glass README · License：[MIT](LICENSE)
